reason: With Enter on the All Cashflow button, focus moves into the menu onto the radio All Cashflow, with a visible ring. That radio is the first item in the menu, which holds one radio group of three radios, so focus is on the first item and the sweep's claim does not hold.

The popup is role=menu but its only child is a radiogroup of native radios, which role=menu does not allow (probe-33136dfa9856 reads menu "All Cashflow"), so 1.3.1 still fails. The radios keep their names, checked state and arrow-key movement (Down moved focus and selection to Money In, Up moved it back) and Enter on the trigger puts focus on the first radio, so the choice can be made and only the wrapper's role is wrong.
